summary: List Work Order Contract detail line items
description: List Detail Line Items on a given Work Order Contract

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[line_item_id]
parameters.description: Line Item ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Line Item ID or within a range of Line Item IDs.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Detail Line Item. Use as the {id} path parameter to show, update, or delete it under its parent contract.

amount.description: Contract amount allocated to this Detail Line Item, as a decimal string in the contract's currency.

description.description: Free-text description of the work or cost this Detail Line Item covers.

position.description: Ordering position of this Detail Line Item within its parent Line Item.

line_item_id.description: ID of the parent contract Line Item this Detail Line Item belongs to.

billed_to_date.description: Cumulative amount billed against this Detail Line Item to date, as a decimal string in the contract's currency.

billed_against.description: True when this Detail Line Item has been billed for a non-zero amount on a previous invoice; false otherwise.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity
